description: 2022 - 2024 NTD Annual Data - Funding Sources (Federal) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. This dataset details federal funding sources for each applicable agency reporting to the NTD in the 2022, 2023, and 2024 report years. Federal funding sources are financial assistance obtained from the Federal Government to assist with the costs of providing transit services. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 18 columns, among them NTD ID, Organization Type, Report Year, UZA Name, Other FTA Funds, Other USDOT Funds,. The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
